description: Add a note (activity entry) to a contact or job's activity feed. record_type_name defaults to Note; use another activity type from the account settings if needed. JobNimbus: POST /activities.

actor.description: Optional JobNimbus user email to act as. The record is created/edited with that user's permissions and shows them as the author. Needs an admin-level API key.

primary_id.description: jnid of the contact or job the note belongs to (sent as primary.id).

record_type_name.description: Activity type name. Defaults to Note.

name: jobnimbus_create_note
title: Add a note
